categories.ja: キャラクタープラモデル

description.ja: メカコレクションに『宇宙戦艦ヤマト2202』に登場の「ガイゼンガン兵器群･カラクルム級戦闘艦」が登場！
description.en: The "Gaisengan Weapon Group Karakrum Class Battleship " from " Space Battleship Yamato 2202" is now available in the Mecha Collection!

description.ja: • 手のひらサイズながら、ガイゼンガン兵器群･カラクルム級戦闘艦のディテールを精密に再現！
description.en: • Although it is palm-sized, it accurately reproduces the details of the Gaizengan weapons group and Karakrum class battleship!

description.ja: • 発売中のメカコレクション 地球連邦アンドロメダ級 一番艦 アンドロメダと同スケールの大型艦隊！
description.en: • Mecha collection being released Earth Federation Andromeda class Large fleet of the same scale as the first ship Andromeda!

description.ja: メカコレクションながら、圧倒的な存在感！
description.en: Although it is a mecha collection, it has an overwhelming presence!

description.ja: • メカコレならではのコレクション性で、複数集めると劇中の登場する「レギオネル・カノーネ」が再現可能に！
description.en: • With the collectability unique to mechanical collection, if you collect multiple pieces, you can recreate the "Legionel Canone" that appears in the play!
